title: רב חיננא בר שילא

paragraphs: Rav Chinena bar Shila: “Rav loved him like a father loves a son.” Sanhedrin 72b, beginning, has Rav saying, “I know of Rav Chanina bar Shila that he has mercy on me like a father on a son”; so too Jerusalem Talmud, end of Ben Sorer. Pesachim 119b: R. Chanina bar Shila and R. Yochanan. Shabbat 58a: Shmuel told R. Chanina bar Shila, “Let none of the rabbis in the exilarch's house go out wearing a sealed cloak except you, because they do not insist upon it in your case.” See Rashi. Arukh, entry Sarbal, explains differently. Yuchasin, under Abba Arikha, writes that Rashi's explanation is primary. Shmuel told him, “Consult and write”: Bava Metzia 15a. Rashi explains that he was a scribe. Eruvin 12a: Shmuel told R. Chananyah bar Shila, “Do not act upon this in practice.”
